stops.detail: The Natural Park of the Levante Peninsula () () is a protected natural space situated in the northeast of the island of Majorca, an autonomous community of the Ises Balears, in the region of Levante. It has 21 507 hectares of land and sea.) It is regarded as an area of particular interest and a special area of bird protection.)
